parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of results to be returned in a single call when NextToken is used for the query.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 50.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros list-diagnostics --diagnostic-key 2829A772-B154-5A0A-B61B-DEE8A9EE8A5D --diagnostic-product ros --status Complete --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f010000 --max-results 50 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ros ListDiagnostics --region cn-hangzhou --Status Complete --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f010000 --DiagnosticKey '2829A772-B154-5A0A-B61B-DEE8A9EE8A5D' --MaxResults 50 --DiagnosticProduct ros
